title: Granular Tabu Search
summary: Toth and Vigo GTS: tabu search on a drastically reduced neighborhood.

attributes.not_the_original: Granular tabu is not cvrp_construct select_next_node.

applicable_regimes.scale_notes: 通过粒度阈值剪枝约 80%-90% 长边，使大 n 下的 Tabu 邻域评估仍保持接近线性稀疏度。

interface_blueprint.skeleton_role: 构建稀疏粒度边集 E_g = {(i,j) : d(i,j) <= beta * z_bar / (n + k)} 并保留仓库边与当前解边；仅在 E_g 诱导的候选移动（relocate/swap/2-opt*）上执行带禁忌表与破禁准则的迭代搜索
interface_blueprint.evolvable_hook: granularity_threshold_schedule(iter, stagnation, z_best) 与 move_penalized_score(delta, freq, tabu_state)
invariants_and_constraints: 仓库关联边始终留在稀疏图中防止断连
停滞期动态放宽 beta 触发多样性重启动
最终输出必须满足严格容量可行
typical_pitfalls: beta 过小导致可行移动过稀陷入死胡同
允许不可行中间解但未实现自适应容量惩罚恢复机制

math_formulation.expr: vartheta = beta * (z_bar / (n + K));   E_g = {(i,j) : d(i,j) <= vartheta} U {(0,i)}
math_formulation.preconditions: 欧氏或度量 CVRP；需配合稀疏邻接表预先过滤候选对
